name: Speaking of Fortitude
summary: Brother Kristoff prepares a sermon in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. For his message on the Fortitude of the Spirit, he seeks a book in Stormwind Keep's Royal Library.

sections.title: A Metaphor in Metal
sections.body: Brother Kristoff, a priest in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, is preparing a sermon on the Fortitude of the Spirit. He wants to draw on the craft of metalworking alongside scripture. To make his point, he needs a treatise called "The Stresses of Iron." Its lessons on bearing pressure may help his congregation understand the strength of faith.

sections.title: The Royal Stacks
sections.body: The Royal Library holds Stormwind's histories, civic writings, and other works within Stormwind Keep. Its shelves contain centuries of writing, so Brother Kristoff sends messengers to Head Librarian Milton Sheaf. Sheaf knows the archive by heart and can guide them to obscure works on crafts.

faq.answer: Brother Kristoff is a priest serving the Church of the Holy Light in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City. He often asks visitors to find materials and references for his teachings and sermons.

faq.q: What book is Brother Kristoff looking for?
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff seeks "The Stresses of Iron," a technical text on metalworking that he plans to cite as a metaphor for spiritual endurance.
Milton Sheaf is the head librarian of the Royal Library inside Stormwind Keep. He oversees the kingdom's books, scrolls, and civic records, and knows the collection well.

faq.q: Where is the Royal Library located?
faq.answer: The Royal Library is in the northeastern wing of Stormwind Keep, reached through the royal palace's main hall.

faq.q: Why does a priest need a metallurgy book?
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff is preparing a sermon titled "Fortitude of the Spirit." He plans to compare iron's stress during forging with the way trials strengthen the human spirit.

faq.q: Does Milton Sheaf have the book ready right away?
faq.answer: Milton Sheaf says the library holds books on metalworking, but he needs to check for the exact title and arrange a search for Kristoff's book.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see how Stormwind's clergy draw on everyday crafts alongside devotion to the Light when teaching spiritual fortitude.
As a blacksmith, you know the forge's hardships. Brother Kristoff plans to use "The Stresses of Iron" to explain endurance under pressure.
As an Alliance member, you can see Cathedral Square's priesthood connected to Stormwind Keep's Royal Library, part of the capital's civic and scholarly life.
